description: This PHP source file defines the SystemCheckAPI class within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class provides an API endpoint for performing a system check, retrieving system status, and handling errors. It uses traits for logging, entity management, and configuration. The class exposes a method to get system check results and implements placeholder methods for update, delete, and validation rules, which are not implemented.
